decisions.context: batchController initiateBatch used per-student session loop
decisions.decision: Replace with two parallel bulkWrite calls (requests + approvals collection)
decisions.trade_offs: Loses per-document Mongoose middleware, but those were not used here. Gains ~30x speed.
Slightly more code per mutation, but prevents thundering-herd cache miss storms at peak load.

decisions.decision: Removed populate — use denormalized facultyName field stored on NodueApproval at creation time
decisions.trade_offs: No extra Faculty collection query on the hot path. Name must be kept in sync on faculty rename (rare).

decisions.context: HoD overview cache not busting after class-teacher/mentor/faculty approvals
decisions.decision: All approval mutations now call invalidateKeys('hod_overview:<deptId>') immediately after transaction commit
decisions.trade_offs: Requires batch.departmentId in every approval function — already fetched for auth checks, so zero extra DB round-trips.

decisions.context: Setup Wizard missing from sidebar and department classes zero-state
decisions.decision: Declared Setup Wizard in NAV_CONFIG for Admin and HoD by default, gated by feature flag only when explicitly disabled; added dual entry points on DepartmentClasses (top action bar + zero-state onboarding card) with automatic department context passing via URL query
decisions.trade_offs: Guarantees zero-latency rendering of wizard navigation, eliminates user confusion when onboarding classes for an empty department.

decisions.context: Write conflict (code 112) when bulk removing subjects mapping
decisions.decision: Replaced frontend Promise.all parallel individual DELETE requests with an atomic POST /api/classes/:id/subjects/bulk-remove endpoint and bulkSyncSubjectRemoval, backed by exponential backoff write conflict retry logic
decisions.trade_offs: Consolidates N concurrent database transactions into 1 atomic mutation, eliminating race conditions and WiredTiger lock contention.

decisions.context: Inconsistent border radii across forms, SearchableSelect (0px inherited bug), cards, and modals
decisions.decision: Established formal CSS custom properties (--radius-micro 6px, --radius-chip 8px, --radius-control 12px/rounded-xl, --radius-surface 16px/rounded-2xl, --radius-pill 9999px/rounded-full) in index.css and normalized all UI primitives, form controls, and cards across client/src
decisions.trade_offs: Eliminates arbitrary border-radius overrides and achieves concentric geometry throughout the application.

decisions.context: Inconsistent button sizes, SearchableSelect multi-line trigger height, and filter/toolbar vertical misalignment across modals and admin/faculty pages
decisions.decision: Enforced deterministic fixed height tiers on Button (xs h-8, sm h-9, md h-10, lg h-11), SearchableSelect triggers (sm h-9, default h-11 with single-line label and subLabel strictly inside dropdown menu + title tooltip), modal inputs (h-11), wizard form controls (h-9), and page filter capsules/action bars (matching h-9 or h-10/h-11 baselines with inline-flex alignment)
decisions.trade_offs: Fixed heights prevent vertical wobble across heterogeneous controls in multi-column grids and horizontal toolbars, at the cost of truncating long subLabels on closed SearchableSelect triggers.

decisions.context: Setup Wizard vertical overflow, redundant accordion cards, student/mentor/elective import blockers, silent PDF failures, and missing batch launch / HoD route bugs
decisions.decision: Converted SetupWizard into a non-scrolling section-tabbed viewport shell using balanced 2-column layouts with internal table scrolling and sticky footers; built shared WizardImportPanel with authenticated .xlsx template downloads and row-level pre-commit validation; made Step 2 (Students), Step 3 (Mentors), and Step 4 (Electives) optional/skippable with exact Class/Directory destination guidance and deferred-setup exit to the role-aware Class Details page; fixed import.controller.js previewStudents ReferenceError, fuzzy header normalization in importUtils.js, email-optional student rows, Step 1 PDF error recovery & pageCache edit sync, URL ?classId progress restoration, and Step 6 actual NodueBatch initiation + HoD navigation paths.
decisions.trade_offs: FR-E2 preflight still gates actual batch launch on >=1 student, so admins skipping student import are routed cleanly to Save Draft & Open Class Page where students can be enrolled, manually added, or promoted before triggering clearance.

decisions.context: Setup Wizard Save & Open Class Page navigated to 404 Class not found when previously soft-deleted sections matched timetable auto-discovery
decisions.decision: Scoped timetableController inspectTimetablePdf, previewTimetable, and batchImportTimetable queries to active classes (isActive: true) so soft-deleted sections are never hijacked; rejected inactive classes with 404 in wizardService; prevented infinite 404/403 retry toasts in ClassDetail and added Back Navigation recovery on Sync Error
decisions.trade_offs: Soft-deleted historical sections remain safely preserved without obstructing fresh Setup Wizard runs for the same section name.

decisions.context: Setup Wizard Step 1 double-upload race, unconfirmed preview class pollution, duplicate Roman-prefix sections, alphanumeric elective code truncation, crushed table height, and post-wizard curriculum visibility
decisions.decision: Eliminated FileDropzone emitFile double-callback invocation and added inspectInFlightRef + sequence guards in Step1ClassSubjects; made previewTimetable read-only on Class when previewOnly=true so classes are provisioned only on Confirm or Batch Provision; introduced shared classIdentity canonical Roman-prefix regex + async in-process lock across classController and timetableController returning 409 DB_003 on duplicate active sections; fixed timetableParser code regexes across tabular/inspect/fallback branches for codes like 23CSD4M01; redesigned Step 1 into a roomy 2-column review layout (Section Details + Detected Sections left, spacious full-title Extracted Curriculum table right) and added Verified Section & Curriculum Summary panels in Step6Preflight and Step7Initiation.
decisions.trade_offs: In-process lock serializes concurrent class mutations on a single Node instance; MongoDB unique partial index remains a future cluster-wide enhancement if multi-instance horizontal scaling is deployed without sticky routing or distributed locks.

decisions.context: Multi-page timetable PDF Setup Wizard saved only the active section instead of all extracted PDF sections and used N+1 sequential queries while dropping isElective on parseTimetablePdf/Master Curriculum and missing classes:list:dept_all cache invalidation
decisions.decision: Built single-pass executeBulkTimetableProvisioning pipeline behind POST /api/timetable/bulk-commit and refactored batchImportTimetable to share it with bulkUpsertSubjects (<=3 DB round-trips), ordered multi-key locking, single PDF text extraction via parseTimetablePageFromText, Class.bulkWrite for operational classes + semesterSubjects (preserving isElective) + Master Curriculum hydration, TimetableUpload.insertMany, and full dept+dept_all cache invalidation in cacheHooks; added PUT /api/wizard/classes/bulk-progress; updated Step1ClassSubjects to auto-select all extractable sections and merge pageCache edits on Confirm All; carried provisionedClasses cohort state + switcher through WizardProgressHeader, SetupWizard, Step6Preflight, and Step7Initiation.
decisions.trade_offs: Multi-section PDFs save all checked sections in Step 1 Confirm with page-level error isolation (non-table cover pages land cleanly in skippedPages) rather than deferring Class creation past Step 2-6 since student/mentor/elective steps require existing classIds.

decisions.context: Setup Wizard UI felt visually clumsy from nested bordered cards, stacked chrome headers, and bright amber borders across unmatched PDF rows
decisions.decision: Redesigned SetupWizard into a unified Workspace Studio inspired by OneSchema Studio, Amie/Kinhive onboarding, and The Bluejack Group Dashboard: collapsed the top header into a single slim row + hairline progress track, moved the 6-step navigation into a calm left vertical WizardStepRail (with horizontal scrollable pills on mobile), made StepContainer and Step1ClassSubjects flush hairline workspaces (edge-to-edge multi-section sidebar + 4-col inline Section Metadata bar + OneSchema hairline curriculum grid replacing harsh amber box fills with subtle status dots), aligned Step6Preflight readiness cards to crisp white hairline cards, and updated WizardPageSkeleton to match.
decisions.trade_offs: Fixed ~260px left workflow rail + optional ~240px PDF section tree requires horizontal responsiveness at mobile (<lg), handled cleanly via horizontal step pills and stacked collapsible section rail.

decisions.context: Workspace Studio Setup Wizard panels, labels, mode switchers, filter pills, status indicators, and secondary action buttons blended together due to uniform white/pale-zinc surfaces and low-contrast zinc-400 typography
decisions.decision: Applied distinct multi-tier surface contrast (slate-100/85 Workflow rail, slate-50/95 PDF Sections tree & Metadata bar, crisp pure-white editing workspace, and slate-100/85 pinned footers separated by slate-200/300 borders), switched active mode/filter tabs to solid bg-navy text-white pills on slate tracks, differentiated primary/indigo-tinted/outlined-slate buttons, replaced muted zinc-400/500 captions and table headers with WCAG-readable slate-600/700/900 hierarchy, added border-slate-300 to form controls, and styled table statuses/actions as scannable pills across Steps 1-7.
decisions.trade_offs: Maintains neutral hairline aesthetics without returning to heavy full-box amber fills while ensuring instant pane, button, and text differentiation.

decisions.context: Step 1 inner workspace had misaligned Section Metadata inputs (Class Teacher label pill shifting its select downward), truncated faculty/teacher select options, wrapped 2-line Curriculum filter bar, redundant 5th Status column, stacked boxy Section items, and bulky uppercase top-bar controls; Steps 5-6 duplicated multi-section switcher banners
decisions.decision: Simplified Step 1 inner layout in Step1ClassSubjects: replaced bulky uppercase file buttons with compact inline controls (h-7), flattened unselected PDF Section items to borderless rows so only the active section stands out, unified all 4 Section Metadata label heights (h-4 leading-4) and shortened placeholders to 'Select teacher...' and 'Select faculty (optional)...' to eliminate baseline shift and mid-word truncation, forced the Curriculum toolbar onto a single row, consolidated Status dot indicators directly into the Handling Faculty cell to produce a cleaner 4-column table, and slimmed multi-section switcher banners in Step6Preflight and Step7Initiation into single-row chip bars.
decisions.trade_offs: Consolidating the separate Status pill column into an inline semantic dot keeps filter tabs (All/Matched/Pending/Excluded) accurate while giving Subject Name and Handling Faculty columns wider breathing room.

decisions.context: Pre-production cross-check found Linux case-sensitivity boot crash in server/src/app.js ('./routes/wizard.routes.js' vs git 'Routes/'), ERR_ERL_KEY_GEN_IPV6 ValidationError in authLimiter, and three client runtime crashes (missing useEffect import in BatchView, conditional hook calls + missing Button import in BatchStudentDetail, and browser ReferenceError on process.env in ErrorBoundary)
decisions.decision: Fixed server/src/app.js wizardRoutes import casing to './Routes/wizard.routes.js' and re-verified zero case-mismatched imports across server/src and client/src; updated authLimiter in rateLimiter.js to use express-rate-limit ipKeyGenerator(req.ip); added useEffect import in BatchView.jsx; hoisted hooks above early returns and imported Button in BatchStudentDetail.jsx; switched ErrorBoundary.jsx debug block from process.env.NODE_ENV to import.meta.env.DEV.
decisions.trade_offs: Remaining legacy/pre-existing ESLint issues in unused legacy wizard files (Step1ClassInfo, Step2Timetable) and non-wizard pages plus npm audit advisories (12 high in client including xlsx, 8 high + 2 critical in server) are documented for the user's pre-push review rather than risking broad dependency bumps.

decisions.context: Final pre-push cleanup and dependency security patch before V.2.2 push to origin/main
decisions.decision: Resolved all remaining client ESLint errors and warnings to achieve 0 errors / 0 warnings across the full repo (separated NavigationStackContext definition cleanly and eliminated setState-in-effect, fixed useFeatureFlag/useSSE/DepartmentClasses/faculty History/student History/BulkPromoteCohortModal/DepartmentRolloverModal/Batches/Pending and legacy Step1/Step2 lint issues); ran non-breaking npm audit fix reducing client vulnerabilities to 0 and server critical/high down to 2 unresolved items (xlsx with no upstream fix; nodemailer@10.5.0 breaking major bump deferred). Accepting xlsx (parsed strictly server-side from admin/HOD uploads via auth+role middleware and importLimiter) and nodemailer@8 risk temporarily; revisit_if: fix released or safe nodemailer v10 migration window.
decisions.trade_offs: Lockfiles updated within semver bounds; nodemailer major upgrade deferred to avoid email regression without dedicated SMTP integration test coverage.

decisions.context: Importing subjects into Master Syllabus failed in production on MongoDB Atlas with 'Only servers in a sharded cluster can start a new transaction at the active transaction number'
decisions.decision: Eliminated all concurrent Promise.all operations sharing an active MongoDB transactional ClientSession across classController (assignClassTeacher, addSubjectAssignment, cloneSubjects), batchController (initiateBatch, addStudentToBatch), studentController (createStudent, assignMentor, addElective, assignClassTeacher/updateElectiveFaculty), facultyController (bulkResendCredentials, bulkUpdateRoles), and batchSync (regenerateRequestForStudent); added getSessionOptions(session) on Class.save writes and cache invalidation on cloneSubjects; extended executeSafeTransaction fallback detection and added regression tests in server/test/unit/clone-subjects.test.js.
decisions.trade_offs: Replica sets prohibit parallel wire commands per ClientSession; serializing transactional reads/writes adds negligible latency (<2ms) while eliminating txnNumber collisions across all non-sharded Atlas clusters.
